title: Department of Public Health memorandum to retailers on open-shelf access to over-the-counter naloxone
rule_summary: The Department of Public Health memorandum Over the Counter (OTC) Naloxone, dated 12/20/2023, offered by the Bureau of Substance Addiction Services and addressed to Massachusetts retailers, states that people can still access prescription naloxone via patient-specific prescriptions or by utilizing the current statewide standing order from retail pharmacies, and that naloxone labeled for over-the-counter sale will be available to purchase in more locations beyond pharmacy shelves. On placement it states that retailers should enable anonymous access to naloxone directly on a shelf, without locking it behind a cabinet nor in a container that necessitates contacting an employee to access it; that stocking OTC naloxone exclusively behind the counter limits access to the product to those willing to ask to purchase it from a clerk or pharmacy staff member; and that businesses that can select where products will be shelved should consider placing OTC naloxone toward the front of stores or cash registers to maximize visibility.
exam_relevance: Tests that Department guidance contemplates anonymous open-shelf purchase of over-the-counter naloxone without contact with an employee, as distinct from prescription naloxone obtained on a patient-specific prescription or under the statewide standing order, and that the guidance is written as what retailers should do.

authority.name: Department of Public Health memorandum: Over the Counter (OTC) Naloxone (12/20/2023)
authority.section: Memorandum to Massachusetts Retailers, Access options and Placement of OTC naloxone

common_confusions: Treating the memorandum's placement guidance, written as what retailers should do, as a regulatory mandate.
Assuming over-the-counter naloxone has to be kept behind the pharmacy counter and handed over by staff.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 on the Department of Public Health's mass.gov page for the memorandum Over the Counter (OTC) Naloxone, dated 12/20/2023.
